answer.summary: Line 4 of JE-US01-2609-00155 accrues USD 2,307.65 for Cadence Learning certification exam vouchers (120) to 6510 Professional Fees – Consulting. The other three training lines in the same SEP-26 Training accrual batch for this vendor all post to 6910 Training. Past certification exam voucher lines from training suppliers were all coded to 6910, and CC4440 has been used for them before, so keeping the cost centre is fine. September is closed, so the reclass should be approved as proposed: Dr 6910 / Cr 6510, CC4440, posted in OCT-26 on 2026-10-15 with a prior-period reference.
